say:2:1423130001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I spoke with Indris, and we've decided to move forward with our collaboration today.
say:2:1423130001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I spoke with Indris, and we've decided to move forward with our collaboration today.
say:2:1423130001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I spoke with Indris, and we've decided to move forward with our collaboration today.

say:3:1423130002:1.text: So soon? I'm not getting involved unless I know for sure they're trustworthy.
say:3:1423130002:1.source_cn: 怎么这就要正式合作了？如果不能确定他们彻底可信，我是不...

say:4:1423130003:1.text: Relax, Indris will show you around Sal'thorin so you can get a clearer picture of things.
say:4:1423130003:1.source_cn: 放心，因度厄会带你参观萨洛克兰，了解萨洛克兰现在的情况...

say:5:1423130004:1.text: If anything doesn't sit right with you during the negotiation, just speak up anytime.
say:5:1423130004:1.source_cn: 商谈开始后，如果不满意他们提出的条件，你也能随时叫停。

say:7:1423130006:1.text: Indris is probably waiting at the <style="highlight">lift shaft</style> already. Why don't you guys head out first? I'll join you once I wrap up my things here.
say:7:1423130006:1.source_cn: 因度厄应该已经在<style=highlight>王城...

say:8:1423130007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we dwarves are a straightforward bunch. If the discussion later turns sour, I might need you to step in and smooth things over.
